description: Shell script for testing merge-recursive rename options and rename detection in Git, including setup, thresholds, and various test cases.

methods.name: get_expected_stages
methods.description: Sets up expected stages for a given file suffix in the Git repository.

methods.name: rename_detected
methods.description: Checks if renames are detected for a given file suffix.

methods.name: rename_undetected
methods.description: Checks if renames are undetected for a given file suffix.

methods.name: check_common
methods.description: Checks the total number of staged files.

methods.name: check_exact_renames
methods.description: Checks for only exact renames detection.

methods.name: check_no_renames
methods.description: Checks that no renames are detected.
